title: Prior Auth Renewal Risk Radar
oneLiner: A pharmacy operations console that flags specialty medication patients likely to miss therapy because prior authorization renewals, chart notes, or payer follow-ups are drifting late.
targetUser: Specialty pharmacy operations leads, reimbursement coordinators, and clinic medication access teams.
keyUX: Scan renewal risk by therapy value, open one patient lane, and see the exact document or payer step blocking continuity of care.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop pharmacy operations console called Prior Auth Renewal Risk Radar for specialty pharmacy operations leads and reimbursement coordinators. It should help teams prevent therapy interruptions by combining medication value, payer renewal deadlines, missing chart notes, document status, and the next owner action in one decision workspace. Include a therapy-at-risk KPI strip, a renewal priority queue, a payer deadline timeline, a missing-document checklist, a patient cohort risk chart, and a next-action assignment drawer. Design direction: use an operator-dense control-room style with compact modules, sharp hierarchy, dark slate surfaces, high-signal status colors, and crisp workflow emphasis so urgency is visible instantly without feeling chaotic.
